text:
- A circular lifecycle diagram with five steps, featuring icons and text labels:
  - "DESIGN AND SOURCE" at the top with a recycling symbol icon.
  - "MAKE" at the top right with a solar panel icon.
  - "PACKAGE AND SHIP" at the bottom right with a globe icon.
  - "USE" at the bottom left with a plug/plant icon, which is highlighted in green.
  - "RECOVER" at the middle left with an arm/wrench icon.
